summary: Both cases have true local captured-content loss/alteration; neither is only an onset-search miss. Complete packet full-active .98 gate still fails globally. Both captures are exactly identical over acoustic overlap. The historical v5 cause remains unresolved.

method.fullSearch: Both entire saved mono PCM streams, resampled4x; entire first-to-last active reference interval(abs>0.01), unchanged authoritative resample/match; diagnostic argmax also reported when strictmatchfails.
method.fragmentSearch: 30/40ms diagnostic fragments within2seconds of ordered anchor placement; no acceptance credit and displaced periodic matches remain ambiguous.
method.fixedBlocks: 20ms blocks at original ordered time, least-squares gain and normalized correlation; no shifting, no acceptance credit.
method.exactZeroRuns: Native48kHz capture PCM, runs>=1ms; source resampled48kHz to estimate corresponding audible energy.
method.provenance: SHA256 for capture/coreaudio/receipt and each target reference; exact referenceSHA agreeswith originaldualdiagnostic.
